key_insight: CI-EnSF embeds localized forecast-error covariance geometry into score-based transport so observations can inform unobserved state components throughout the analysis trajectory.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a route to more robust data assimilation in nonlinear dynamical systems by combining ensemble covariance structure with nonlinear distributional transport.
method: Shape forward diffusion using localized forecast-error covariance in standardized state space.
Use a control-variable transformation that makes the diffusion isotropic.
Carry covariance-mediated observational information through reverse transport.
evidence_signal: Lorenz-96 and SQG experiments show that a well-tuned LETKF is more accurate for linear observations, while CI-EnSF achieves lower analysis error and greater cycling robustness under strongly nonlinear observations and climatological initialization.
watch_item: Benefits are regime-dependent; the abstract does not establish a general advantage over well-tuned Gaussian ensemble methods.
paper_title: Covariance-Informed Ensemble Score Filtering: Embedding Localized Covariance Geometry into Score-Based Transport
